xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #4905

plan.title: bug(xbrief): drift gate rejects a canonical brief that only quotes the legacy x-vbrief prefix

narratives.Description: `verify:xbrief-drift` fails a canonical brief when any text in it contains the legacy x-vbrief reference prefix, even prose that only quotes it. `scanCorpusToken` in `packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/drift-gate.ts` counts every occurrence as a legacy reference. This story narrows the scan to JSON string values that start with the legacy prefix, such as a reference `type`, so quoting prose passes and a real legacy reference still fails. Pre-commit keeps running the gate with no brief-specific allow-list. This blocks committing the #4846 and #7025 briefs.
narratives.Overview:
## What happened
`verify:xbrief-drift` fails a canonical `xbrief/**/*.xbrief.json` when the file contains the legacy `x-vbrief` reference prefix (x-vbrief followed by a slash), including prose that only quotes that legacy prefix. `scanCorpusToken` in `packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/drift-gate.ts` treats any occurrence as a hit. It does not require a reference `type` field.

The completed #4846 brief quotes the legacy `x-vbrief` prefix inside ingested design-critique comments. It has no reference `type` field whose value starts with that prefix. Pre-commit runs `verify:xbrief-drift --staged --project-root` and does not pass `--allow-list` (`.githooks/pre-commit`). Allow-listing that brief would hide the false positive. Stripping the quoted prefix from that brief to pass the hook is the wrong fix.

The Class B validation change for #4846 is already on master (`18644ed08`, PR 4860). This issue is only the drift scan. The brief stays uncommitted until a quotation is not read as a legacy reference type.

This issue's own text names the prefix without the slash form, because ingest copies the issue into the brief and the current gate would refuse that brief.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given a canonical brief whose only occurrences of the legacy `x-vbrief` prefix are narrative, comment, or contract prose, `verify:xbrief-drift` returns exit 0.
- [ ] A reference object whose `type` starts with the legacy `x-vbrief` prefix still fails.
- [ ] When a brief is committed, pre-commit still runs `verify:xbrief-drift --staged` with no brief-specific allow-list.

Refs #4846, #2109, #4086.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent committing a brief whose prose quotes the legacy x-vbrief prefix, I want `verify:xbrief-drift` to flag only real legacy references, so that I can commit the brief without stripping the quote or allow-listing it.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/drift-gate.ts: drop the any-occurrence half of `scanCorpusToken`. Flag only a JSON string value that starts with the legacy prefix. Prefer checking parsed JSON string values (reference `type` and similar) over a raw substring scan, so escaped quotes inside prose (backslash, quote, then the prefix) do not match (clause 1, clause 2).
2. packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/drift-gate.test.ts: a canonical brief whose only occurrences of the legacy prefix are narrative, comment and contract prose (including an escaped-quote form) passes; a reference object whose `type` starts with the legacy prefix still fails (clauses 1, 2).
3. packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/drift-gate.test.ts: pin that `.githooks/pre-commit` still runs `verify:xbrief-drift --staged` and passes no `--allow-list` (clause 3).
4. changelog.d/4905-drift-gate-prose-quote.md.

issueCommentThread.body: design-critique: not warranted, because this is a precision fix to one existing scanner (`scanCorpusToken` in `packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/drift-gate.ts`), and the acceptance criteria already fix the design: prose quoting the legacy `x-vbrief` prefix passes, a reference `type` that starts with that prefix still fails, and pre-commit keeps the gate with no allow-list. There is no design fork, no new surface and no security question. The gate change is deliberate and goes through this issue and its PR (#3156).
